name: warming up in lunge (one)
description: Lunge warm-up, part 1: hold a low lunge with both arms reaching overhead to open the front of the rear hip.
instructions: Step one foot forward into a low lunge and lower the rear knee onto padding.
Keep the front foot planted and raise both arms overhead while lengthening your torso.
Gently move the hips forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the rear hip.
Return the arms, change legs, and repeat without forcing the range.
